title: Auto-append ~/.local/bin to PATH in user shell rc
description: When installBeadsViewer runs on Linux/macOS, perles drops a binary at ~/.local/bin but doesn't modify rc files. Append the export to ~/.bashrc and ~/.zshrc if missing so VS Code+bash works out of the box.

title: Replace Setup incomplete warning from bd init
description: bd init --shared-server prints 'Setup incomplete: No dolt database found' but doctor confirms the DB is fine. Misleading message. Could suppress in agentstack output.

title: Wire beads viewer install into agentstack
description: Add perles (Linux/macOS) and beads_viewer (Windows) to the installer flow. Already done — keep as completed example.

title: Phantom database beads_global appears in bd doctor

title: Document --shared-server choice in README
description: agentstack runs bd init --shared-server. README should explain why (one process across projects, per-project DB isolation) so users understand the architecture.
